items.title: Eddie Johnson Interview, 1962-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Johnny St. Cyr still uses a six-string... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah. He's got one out of Disneyland, huh? Never run into that.

ctx.x: Around, 1930. About when the big bands started coming in, did the big bands sound? Yeah, they were using bands, everything.

Mm-hmm. Johnny St. Cyr still uses a six-string. Really? Oh, yeah. Yeah, he still uses it. He's got one out of Disneyland, huh? Never run into that. Well, you'll see him. I'll show you some pictures of him. Yeah. All right. Why don't you sit here and watch it? Because I'm afraid my voice is a little loud from here. He just swaps. He plays, uh, he used to play with William Strong, too, at the time. He was strong. Yeah.
He gets all band jobs. We've got some wonderful records with him on. Yeah.
